title: Songstress extension manifest
description: The songstress.json file at the root of an extension's package: what the extension is, how it is listed, the code it ships, the permissions it asks for and everything it adds to Songstress.

$schema.description: The address of this schema, so an editor can check the file as you type.

manifestVersion.description: The version of the manifest format. Always 1.

id.description: The extension's identity, as publisher.name. It never changes once the extension is installed anywhere.

version.description: The extension's own version, as a semantic version (1.4.0). A release is tagged with it.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the extension does, shown under its name.

engines.description: The extension API the extension was written for.

license.description: The licence of the extension's code, as an SPDX identifier (MIT, Apache-2.0).

sponsor.description: Where people can support the author.

categories.description: The one category the extension is listed under.

keywords.description: Free tags that help people find the extension.

platforms.description: The Songstress apps the extension's interface and client code work in. Left out, it means all of them. Code in the server entry reaches every app whatever this says.

banner.description: The wide image on the extension's card.

screenshots.description: Captures of the extension at work. The official list asks for three to six.

entry.description: The extension's code: one JavaScript bundle for each side it runs on.

hooks.description: The hooks the extension's code listens to. Songstress starts the code when one of them fires.

permissions.description: What the extension asks to be allowed to do. Nothing is allowed unless it is asked for here and then granted by a person.

contributes.description: What the extension adds to Songstress.

extensionId.description: publisher.name, each part in lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.

localId.description: A name unique among its kind inside one extension: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

settingKey.description: A setting's name as code reads it: letters and digits, starting with a lowercase letter.

iconName.description: A name from Songstress's icon set. A name an app does not know is drawn as the extension mark.

title.description: A short label, on one line.

sentence.description: A sentence or two, on one line.

url.description: The page where people can support the author.

songstress.description: The versions of the extension API the extension runs on, as a range: ^1.2.0, ~1.2.0, >=1.2.0, >=1.2.0 <2.0.0 or one exact version. Never *.

category.description: A category of the official list.

keyword.description: A tag: lowercase letters and digits, with single dots or hyphens between them.

platform.description: A Songstress app: the web app, the desktop app, the iPhone and iPad app, the Android app.

side.description: Where code runs: in the server entry or in the client entry.

icon.description: A square PNG of 512 by 512 pixels.

path.description: The PNG file, from the package root.

banner.description: A 16:9 image, from 1280 by 720 up to 3840 by 2160 pixels.

path.description: The PNG, JPEG or WebP file, from the package root.

screenshot.description: One capture, with the size it really has.

path.description: The PNG, JPEG or WebP file, from the package root.

caption.description: What the capture shows, also read aloud by screen readers.

platform.description: The app the capture was taken in.

server.description: The bundle that runs on the user's server, in a sandbox. It hears every app's plays and does the work that must go on while no app is open.

client.description: The bundle that runs inside an app while it is open, in a sandbox. It follows this device's player live. An app may not run client code at all: what must work everywhere belongs in the server entry.

scriptPath.description: One JavaScript file, from the package root.

server.description: Hooks the server entry listens to.

client.description: Hooks the client entry listens to.

serverHook.description: A hook of the server entry.

clientHook.description: A hook of the client entry.

reason.description: Why the extension needs this, in words the person granting it will read.

hosts.description: The public hosts the extension may reach, over http or https.

hostPattern.description: A public host by name (api.example.com), or every host under a domain (*.example.com), with an optional port. Never an address, a scheme or a path.

targets.description: The targets on the user's own network the extension asks for. Left out, the admin names them when granting.

localTarget.description: A target on the user's own network: an IPv4 address (192.168.1.20), a block of them (192.168.1.0/24) or a host name (nas.local), the address and the name with an optional port.

network.local.description: Reach targets on the user's own network.

library.read.description: Read the catalogue and hear when it changes.

users.read.description: Read members' ids and display names.

listening.read.description: Read a member's plays, what they are playing now and what they like. Each member grants it for themselves.

player.control.description: Start, pause, skip and seek the player of the device the code runs on, and add to its queue.

storage.description: Keep its own data, under a quota.

commands.description: Named actions the extension's code carries out.

menus.description: Where the extension's commands appear in the apps.

settings.description: The settings Songstress draws and keeps for the extension, in the order they are shown.

pages.description: Pages the apps draw from a tree of Songstress's own components.

panels.description: Sections drawn inside Songstress's own screens.

views.description: Free-form pages: the extension's own HTML in a sandboxed frame. An app may not show them at all.

providers.description: Sources the extension adds beside Songstress's own, by kind.

jobs.description: Scheduled and background work, shown in Activity.

routes.description: Signed-in JSON routes under the extension's own prefix.

signIn.description: A sign-in to the service the extension reaches, which a person starts and ends in Songstress.

id.description: The command's name. Code registers its handler under it.

title.description: The label on the menu item or button that runs it.

run.description: The entry that holds the command's handler.

song/context.description: A song's menu. The command receives the song.

album/context.description: An album's menu. The command receives the album.

artist/context.description: An artist's menu. The command receives the artist.

playlist/context.description: A playlist's menu. The command receives the playlist.

queue/item.description: The menu of a song waiting in the queue. The command receives the song.

player/actions.description: The player's own menu. The command receives the song that is playing.

sidebar.description: The sidebar of the web and desktop apps.

settings/actions.description: Buttons on the extension's own settings page.

command.description: The id of one of the extension's commands.

settingScope.description: Who a setting belongs to: the whole server (the admin sets it), each member, or each device.

setting.description: One setting. Its type decides the control Songstress draws and what else it may say.

key.description: The name code reads the setting by.

description.description: A line of help under the label.

required.description: Songstress asks for it, and does not start the extension for whoever lacks it: anyone, a member or a device, by its scope.

default.description: The value until someone sets one.

placeholder.description: The hint shown while the field is empty.

maxLength.description: The longest value accepted, in characters.

secretSetting.description: A password, key or token. Songstress seals it, never shows it again and never sends it to an app. A device cannot keep one.

key.description: The name code reads the setting by.

description.description: A line of help under the label.

scope.description: Who the secret belongs to: the whole server or each member.

required.description: Songstress asks for it, and does not start the extension for whoever lacks it: anyone, a member or a device, by its scope.

placeholder.description: The hint shown while the field is empty.

key.description: The name code reads the setting by.

description.description: A line of help under the label.

required.description: Songstress asks for it, and does not start the extension for whoever lacks it: anyone, a member or a device, by its scope.

default.description: The value until someone sets one.

step.description: The distance between two values the control offers.

key.description: The name code reads the setting by.

description.description: A line of help under the label.

default.description: The value until someone sets one.

key.description: The name code reads the setting by.

description.description: A line of help under the label.

required.description: Songstress asks for it, and does not start the extension for whoever lacks it: anyone, a member or a device, by its scope.

default.description: The value of the option chosen until someone picks one.

options.description: The choices, in the order they are shown.

value.description: What code reads when this option is chosen.

id.description: The page's name. Code registers its renderer under it, and it is the page's address.

render.description: The entry that builds the page's tree. A page built in the server entry shows in every app.

icon.description: The icon of the page's sidebar entry.

sidebar.description: Give the page an entry in the sidebar of the web and desktop apps.

panelLocation.description: The Songstress screen a panel is drawn in: the player's now-playing view, Home, an artist's page or an album's page.

id.description: The panel's name. Code registers its renderer under it.

render.description: The entry that builds the panel's tree.

id.description: The view's name, and its address.

path.description: The HTML file the frame opens, from the package root.

icon.description: The icon of the view's sidebar entry.

sidebar.description: Give the view an entry in the sidebar of the web and desktop apps.

id.description: The theme file's name inside the extension.

label.description: The name of the theme family, as the picker shows it.

path.description: The theme file, from the package root: a family of colour variants as JSON.

catalogType.description: A kind of thing a source lists.

providerGroup.description: One of Songstress's own catalogues. A source that reads the same catalogue joins its group and speaks its ids.

lookup.description: Sources that open one track, album, artist or playlist by its id.

links.description: Sources that read a pasted link.

metadata.description: Sources of facts about artists, releases and tracks.

artwork.description: Sources of artist photos and album covers.

scrobble.description: Services that plays are reported to.

play.description: Sources that can play what their own search found. Switched off until the admin turns each on.

download.description: Sources songs can be acquired from. Switched off until the admin turns each on.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

group.description: The catalogue of Songstress's own whose results this source's are merged with. Left out, the source is a group of its own.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

group.description: The catalogue of Songstress's own whose ids this source speaks. Left out, the source is a group of its own.

types.description: What it can open by id.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

group.description: The catalogue of Songstress's own whose links this source reads. Left out, the source is a group of its own.

patterns.description: The links it reads. The longest pattern that fits a link wins.

linkPattern.description: A host with an optional path that a link must begin with (soundcloud.com, example.com/album/), or an app link's scheme (spotify:). A host also takes links to the hosts under it.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

group.description: The catalogue of Songstress's own whose artist ids this source speaks. Left out, the source is a group of its own.

supports.description: What it answers: an artist's discography (their releases, their most played songs, a release's tracks), or the missing facts of one track.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

modes.description: What it recommends from: one song, one artist, or a list of songs.

id.description: The source's name inside the extension. Code registers the provider under it; the same id under several kinds is one source.

name.description: The source's name as people read it. Left out, it is the extension's name.

qualities.description: The qualities it offers, best first. The admin picks one.

id.description: The quality's name, as code receives it.

title.description: The quality as people read it (AAC 256 kbps).

id.description: The job's name. Code registers its handler under it.

title.description: The job as Activity shows it.

every.description: How often the job runs by itself: a number and m, h or d (15m, 6h, 1d). Left out, the job runs only when code starts it.

id.description: The route's name. Code registers its handler under it.

path.description: The path under the extension's own prefix: segments of lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens and underscores, or :name for a part the handler reads (/charts/:period).

scope.description: Whose account it is. "server": one account for the whole server, which its admin signs in.

title.description: The service as the sign-in names it (Tunelog). Left out, the extension's name.
